name: AeroVerse
summary: 面向无人机具身世界模型的综合基准套件，论文描述了真实与仿真的预训练数据、五类指令微调数据以及覆盖感知、推理、导航、规划和动作的评测。
summaryEn: A UAV embodied-world-model benchmark suite describing real and simulated pretraining data, five instruction-tuning datasets, and evaluation across perception, reasoning, navigation, planning, and action.
scale: 10K real image-text samples · 500K simulated aligned samples · five 3K instruction datasets
